notes: SAMPLE DATA: this file was hand-written for frontend development, not generated by scripts/fetch_blocks.py against the live node (this sandbox cannot reach ethereum-wg). The 3 proposals above are realistic placeholders (real validator indices/pubkeys, plausible slot/block numbers and revenue) based on this fleet's actual validator set, not real measured proposals — run the script for real and commit its output to replace this.

Proposed-block discovery walks realized beacon headers and matches proposer_index against our validator set — this reads already-finalized chain data, not scheduled-duty state, so it works at any historical depth on this node, unlike fetch_performance.py's near-head-only duty scan.

scanProgress reflects a genuinely partial, resumable scan: the recent window (slots 14803729-14823808) matches earnings.json's own real 20000-slot scan, which found zero proposals there — consistent with this fleet's honest ~1-proposal-per-1-2-months rate. The 3 sample proposals above are placed in an older, not-yet-really-scanned window (9000000-9020000) so they don't contradict that real recent-window result. fullHistoryComplete is false: coverage does not yet reach oldestValidatorActivationSlot (17792, our oldest validator's activation). Re-run scripts/fetch_blocks.py repeatedly to extend coverage.

MISSED slots are intentionally not reported here — a header-walk can tell you a slot had no block, but not who was assigned to it. Attributing a miss to one of OUR validators specifically requires the proposer-duty schedule, which this node can only compute cheaply for roughly the last 5-9 epochs of head (see fetch_performance.py's documented constraint); older epochs time out. Only fetch_performance.py's near-head duty scan (confirmedMisses) can honestly claim a miss was ours, and only going forward from whenever that tracking started.

priorityFeeRevenueEth uses the same method as earnings.json: eth_getBlockReceipts, sum((effectiveGasPrice - baseFeePerGas) * gasUsed). builderPaymentNote is the same unverified 21000-gas-last-tx heuristic used there — treat revenue as priority-fee only, it may undercount true block value if a real builder payment is present.
